name: Todoroki Asuka
source: A magic using demon hunter from the magical world. She confronts Kohei in order to stop him from using the powers he got from [url=/c93356]Tsuyoshi[/url]. Instead she's defeated and raped. Full of pride but worried about her ability to succeed, she continues to try and defeat Kohei in order to bring the world back in order. Her sister [url=/c64895]Sanae[/url] only laughs at her misfortune at being raped and offers no help, only asking if she enjoyed it.
